feedback_rules.description: Distinguish between controlled strikes and dangerous contact
Recognize expressive variation in rhythm and movement
Camera cannot assess adherence to ceremonial protocols

learning_units.description: Learn basic stick handling and fighting stance
Perform basic strikes and parries within the gayelle

prerequisites.description: Ability to handle a stick safely

social_formats.description: Solo and paired stick-fighting roles within a circular arena
Musicians and spectators form an outer circle providing rhythm and chants

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Stick handling with strikes, parries, and controlled arm movements
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Danced in a circular arena (gayelle) with fighters in the center
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Engaged for balance and movement, mimicking combat motions
movement_profile.posture: Balanced fighting stance with knees bent, upright torso

signature_moves.description: A controlled forward strike with the stick aimed at the opponent
signature_moves.name: Stick strike

signature_moves.description: Deflecting an opponent's strike using the stick
signature_moves.name: Parry

signature_moves.description: In some Haitian variants, dancers jump over water bottles to demonstrate agility
signature_moves.name: Jump over bottle

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Energetic and rhythmic, matching percussion and chants
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid actual violent strikes to prevent injury Respect ceremonial rituals and do not perform sacred elements without permission

music_profile.musical_form: Improvised call-and-response within a rhythmic percussion framework
music_profile.vocal_style: Lead vocalist (chantwell) sings call-and-response chants to encourage fighters

basic_steps: Enter the gayelle (circle) with a stick in hand
Assume a balanced fighting stance with knees slightly bent
Perform rhythmic stick strikes and parries with controlled arm movements
Incorporate footwork to advance, retreat, and dodge within the circle
Respond to call-and-response chants by adjusting energy and timing
teaching.formation: Performed in a circular arena (gayelle) with fighters in the center and musicians and spectators forming the outer circle
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start by learning basic stick handling, stance, and rhythm synchronization with chants; advanced practitioners engage in full stick-fighting contests.
teaching.rhythm: Lively, energetic, driven by percussion with call-and-response vocal chants
